mapper.select: SELECT id, package_code AS packageCode, package_name AS packageName, description, department_exam AS departmentExam, lab_exam AS labExam, medical_exam AS medicalExam, other_exam AS otherExam, exam_items AS examItems, cover_image AS coverImage, original_price AS originalPrice, current_price AS currentPrice, sales_volume AS salesVolume, package_type AS packageType, tags, category_id AS categoryId, promotion_id AS promotionId, status, md5_hash AS md5Hash, update_time AS updateTime, create_time AS createTime FROM med_exam_package WHERE md5_hash = #{md5Hash} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into med_exam_package (package_code, package_name, description, department_exam, lab_exam, medical_exam, other_exam, cover_image, original_price, current_price, sales_volume, package_type, tags, category_id, promotion_id, status, md5_hash) values (#{packageCode}, #{packageName}, #{description}, #{departmentExam}, #{labExam}, #{medicalExam}, #{otherExam}, #{coverImage}, #{originalPrice}, #{currentPrice}, 0, #{packageType}, #{tags}, #{categoryId}, #{promotionId}, 0, #{md5Hash})
mapper.select:

AND status = #{status}

select id, package_code as packageCode, package_name as packageName, description, cover_image as coverImage, original_price as originalPrice, current_price as currentPrice, sales_volume as salesVolume from med_exam_package where status = 1
and ( package_name like concat("%",#{keyword},"%") or package_code like concat("%",#{keyword},"%") )
and package_type = #{packageType}
and JSON_CONTAINS (tags, CONCAT('"',#{sex},'"'))
and current_price >= 0 and current_price < 100
and current_price >= 100 and current_price < 500
and current_price >= 500 and current_price < 1000
and current_price >= 1000
order by id desc
order by sales_volume desc
order by current_price asc
order by current_price desc
order by sales_volume desc, id desc
limit #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}
